test_open_spiel_wrapper_tic_tac_toe: test the OpenSpielWrapper by wrapping a tic_tac_toe RL environment and verifying observation and action specs
run_open_spiel_wrapper_test: run the OpenSpielWrapperTest suite to validate the wrapper converts OpenSpiel environments to dm_env format
review_open_spiel_wrapper_observation_sp: review the OpenSpielWrapper observation_spec method to verify it returns an OLT namedtuple with observation, legal_actions, and terminal arrays
review_open_spiel_wrapper_action_spec: review the OpenSpielWrapper action_spec method to verify it returns a DiscreteArray with correct bounds and dtype
test_open_spiel_wrapper_step_and_reset: test the OpenSpielWrapper reset and step methods by resetting the environment and stepping with a single action
